description: We are so proud that Robyn represents our district. Her commitment to fairness and equity is unmatched. From authoring the Fair Maps legislation to working to ensure that all kids have access to high quality education, Robyn works tirelessly to improve our community. Robyn has been an advocate for families, teachers, and schools for a long time and that has only increased since she took office. In the face of governmental division that would discourage many, Robyn continues to work across the aisle, ensuring bipartisan support to advance legislation to improve our community and Wisconsin.

title: Jody | Robyn For WI
